limitations.note: The rewrite kept the two-input cadence instead of making count 2 reachable and using it to emit the second packed word on the third valid input.
The rewrite changed the first output word to use the second byte’s low nibble, although the original code and the correct fix both use its high nibble.
The passing test expected no output on the third valid input, encoding the rewrite’s pairing assumption instead of checking that the third byte completes the second packed word.
